prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A wide horizontal band of pale aurora cyan-green with faint purple
undertones, soft-edged and ribbon-like, painterly with suggested wisps
and fade-outs. Intended as an overlay accent.
formatted_prompt: Painterly ink-and-watercolor illustration on aged parchment, wide horizontal composition filling the frame edge to edge. A luminous ribbon of aurora-cyan and cool emerald green sweeps across the full width, soft-edged and atmospheric, with faint violet-purple undertones bleeding through the deeper bands. The aurora dissolves at both ends into pale wisps and feathered fade-outs, layered in richly pigmented watercolor washes — cyan at #4A90C5 intensity in the brightest core, deepening toward slate-shadow margins. Subtle prismatic shimmer traces the ribbon's inner edge, suggesting refracted spectralum-crystal light. Clean whites hold at the upper field, deep midnight-blue shadow anchors the lower register. Loose wet-on-wet brushwork, fine ink hatching at the wisp tips, gentle grain from cold-press paper beneath. No figures, no architecture — pure atmospheric band, coherent and meditative, aurora-light rendered at full luminous saturation.
